title: Baatu Defiance
intro: Bu yàgg balaa nit ku njëkk ki di dundu ci kaw suuf, amoon na mbindéef bu am doole bu rëy bu taxawoon ci barabu jàmm ju mat sëkk, ruuh yu gëna gëm Yàlla wër ko. Suñu joxee benn ndigal, baat bu nekk dafay sukku ngir wane ni dafa déggal, waaye benn baat dafay jog ngir ñaawlu, te ñaawlu googu dafay yegg ba ci jamono yépp ba ci bis bi mujj. Kan mooy mbindéef bu daanu bii?
clues: Dañu ma bindee ci luy tàkk bu baax, ñeneen ñi ci sama wet ñu ngi leen jëlee ci li ñuy dox.
Maa ngi dëkkoon ci barab bu sell ci biir mbindéef yu gëm Yàlla, ba benn ndigal soppi lépp.
Bi ñu joxe ndigal, bépp nit sukku, lu moy man; sama bañ mingi juddoo ci réy-réy.
Ñu dàq ma ci barab bu sell ba, ñu teg ma ci musiba buy yàgg ba fàww.
Maa ngi ñaan Yàlla mu may ma jot ba Bis-pénc ba, mu nangu ma ko. Ma waat ni dinaa jege bépp ruuh, réerloo leen.
Bu liit bi sobee, ñi ma topp dinañu bokk sama musiba, ànd ak man ci safara suy tàkk, fu kenn dimbalikat mënu leen musal.

outcome.answer: Dëddu leen, ak noppalu ba ci bis bi ñu digoon

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
